infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BallOut uses your location to show nearby basketball courts and games around you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BallOut can use your location to help you find and get notified about nearby pickup games.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BallOut needs camera access so you can take a profile photo or add highlight videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BallOut needs photo library access so you can choose a profile photo or upload highlights.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BallOut needs microphone access when you record highlight videos with sound.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BallOut may save media to your library when you choose to keep a copy.
